answer: Proposed: each paid agent issuing grove or orchard ember alerts needs a human sponsor at a daily globally synchronized 10-minute in-person check. Registrars witness full attendance and sign one key/person/day; validators check ticket dates, keys and signatures, denying subsidy for missing, invalid or reused tickets. Corrupt registrars can fake attendance; rented sponsors let one owner run many keys. Phones are reusable capital; no stake is locked; attendance time recurs. Shared servers cannot reuse tickets: ten paid keys need ten people and 100 person-minutes daily, even in parallel.
